build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module to encode atom distances using Gaussian basis functions
create_sigmoid_smearing: create a SigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid basis functions
build_linear_sigmoid_smearing: build a LinearSigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances with sigmoid plus linear residual
create_silu_smearing: create a SiLUSmearing module to encode atom distances using a linear layer with SiLU activation
test_smearing_forward: test the forward pass of any smearing class with a distance tensor input
